provider_reliability.429_detail: Rate limit reached for openai/gpt-oss-safeguard-20b (Groq on_demand tier), TPM limit 8000, during merchant M3 rep2. System fell back to deterministic decider and STILL completed correctly (llm_calls=1, status=completed) — deterministic fallback acted as the safety net.
provider_reliability.fallback_safety: merchant_agent._next_action catches LLM exception -> llm_disabled=True -> _fallback_decide deterministic brain -> transaction completes safely. No payment authority lost.

qwen_partial_latency_from_aborted_full_r.note: qwen/qwen3.8-27b latency is highly variable on Groq (1.3s to 28s for the same scenario); often 10-20x slower than gpt-oss models. Full matrix aborted to protect quota; min-set (1 rep/scenario) completed for buy_amul,multi,stock_fail,cancel,payment_status,reject_alternative,completed_followup,unrelated.

notes: No candidate was deployed. All benchmarks ran in-process with PAYMENT_DRIVER=sim (money parked), deterministic merchant brain fixed for buyer scenarios (MA_LLM_BRAIN=false) to isolate the buyer model; merchant scenarios ran live merchant brain (MA_LLM_BRAIN=true) with only settings.llm_model varied.
